items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 23 June 2026 at 5:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the North Sea covers the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, but Southeast 4 occasionally 5 in the east of the area at first, becoming Variable 3 or less in all waters around midday, settling Variable or Northerly 2 to 4 this evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist or fog patches developing this morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in any mist patches, or very poor in any fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable or Northerly 2 to 4, veering East 3 or 4 occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.
